{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Thunder''''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tobal Siy]]. [[N-3PO]], a [[Shard (species)|Shard]] agent posing as a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], was planted aboard the ''Thunder'' as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
